attacks.claim_at_risk: An aligned difference might be inaccessible to the terminal fitted rule, or the minimum-coordinate reference might be credited to learning.
attacks.method: Derive the equivalence of aligned supports under uncut translations and compare it to the issued tree paths and training-derived tie preference.
attacks.finding: Alignment subtracts the independent occupied row and column minima. Equal nonempty aligned codes imply supports that differ by translation, since each support is recovered by adding back its offsets. This construction provides oriented coordinates and translation invariance. A depth-three greedy tree can still miss an available distinction, as when each separate bit of a two-bit parity target has zero Gini gain. Candidate thresholds are observed lower values with equality routed left, and the lower feature address then lower threshold resolves an exact positive-gain tie. Tracing the fitted path and counting split ties after sealing distinguishes these supplied choices from evidence contributed by training.

attacks.claim_at_risk: An overall gain could hide failure on one class or held turn, or 16 translations could be counted as independent drawings.
attacks.method: Compare primary strata, fresh-design weighting, gains and losses on shared cases, and separately scored diagnostic and familiar-turn outputs.
attacks.finding: For each reader and law, primary success requires a strict majority in all 64 design, true-letter, held-turn and position cells, each containing eight placements. Both feature encodings are translation invariant, so this requires correct classification of all 32 underlying held design–letter–turn units before possible signature coincidences. A claimed position-sensor transfer advantage requires the position tree to pass, the matched window tree to fail, and more paired gains than losses by drawing. Both laws reach the full census even if the known pair was missed.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Reversal after a whole-state swap could be described as discovering the coordinate frame, choosing a unique split or acquiring a general rule for rotation.
attacks.method: Compare the invariance of Gini to a relabeling against the scored swap controls and the disclosed instrumentation for trained ties.
attacks.finding: Exchanging class labels leaves every Gini improvement and deterministic split tie unchanged. It can reverse non-tied leaf decisions. Whole-state swaps, restoration, blanks and the arithmetic controls establish how the complete stored classifier governs its issued bit on fixed pixels. Per-node best-split ties, paired reader outputs, and post-release sensor and leaf collisions can explain a success or failure on this census. Unique feature discovery would require evidence distinguishing equally fitted alternatives.
